title: dianthus caryophyllus subsp. sylvestris
intro: Dianthus caryophyllus subsp. sylvestris, commonly known as Wild Carnation or Woods Carnation, is a subspecies of the Carnation plant that is native to the mountainous regions of Europe. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional folk medicine to promote relaxation and reduce stress, due to its sedative and calming effects. The health benefits of Dianthus caryophyllus subsp. sylvestris include its ability to reduce anxiety and insomnia, while its therapeutic actions include its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antispasmodic properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, such as carvone and limonene, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
